answer: An agent economy can weight votes by collateral locked for 30 days, using stake as the signal of influence. A thousand identities then carry no more weight than one holding the same total stake. Like grains piled into a dune, extra accounts rearrange what is already there. To gain 51% of voting power, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more stake than all honest voters combined, leaving that capital as slow to move as a glacier.
